verdict.rationale: Devin's docs describe delegating tasks and then 'taking over in Devin's IDE' or 'jumping in' to help with browsing tasks, implying some interactivity with an active session, but there is no explicit documentation of sending follow-up chat instructions to steer an in-progress session without restarting it. missing for 10: explicit docs on mid-session chat/steering, confirmation that follow-up messages are incorporated live, independent hands-on evidence of this workflow.
